text_block_list.text:
While busy days were spent preparing for the Make Debut,
the Academy was buzzing with a certain piece of news—
Of the "Classic Triple Crown" that an Umamusume can only challenge once in her lifetime—namely, the Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and Kikuka Sho—

“The ‘Monster’ Narita Brian claims back-to-back victories
in the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).”

With a Triple Crown Umamusume finally within reach,
the racing world was buzzing with excitement.
Reporters and fans continued to visit the academy day after day, forcing us to restrict tours and media coverage in order to maintain a calm environment.

Naturally, the students were buzzing with excitement,
though some had quite a different reaction—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hrrrrrrrrrrmmm???

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Squirming? Throbbing? Something feels weird!
I sense a novel aura somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you feel it?
This gloomy, frustrating,
totally un-marvelous vibe!

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the reporters were here again, weren't they...?
I know she's amazing, but it's always Brian-san, Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, she's in a whole different league from us.
*sigh*... Why are we in the same class?
If only we were from a different generation...

Lately, stories like this had become a common occurrence.
Some were starting to feel intimidated by Narita Brian's fierce, overpowering running style.
A bright light casts a dark shadow. Even so, just as I was thinking that was simply part and parcel of the competitive world—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooh, ooh, mee! Question!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why are you being so marvelous??
Are you that curious about Brian??

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text: Huh... Who is this? An acquaintance of yours?

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Dunno—also,
would you mind not talking to me out of nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Guess what? I'm Marvelous Sunday☆ And I've come to deliver Marvelous to you all★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So if you're troubled, tell me!
Let's go find the marvelous together!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Gross.
Like, I seriously don't want it.

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text: Even if I tell you, you wouldn't understand anyway...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why?? You won't know if they don't understand
unless you actually talk to them, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Brian's famous, so
I've at least watched her races—

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Aah, geez, shut up already!
I'm saying it's pointless talking to anyone who isn't from the same generation as that famous "Monster"!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Because nobody's ever said that to you, have they?! 'Brian's the strongest of this generation,' 'No one can match Brian'—things like that!"

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Listen, we've been treated like that ever since our debut! "Brian is amazing! Brian is the strongest of the generation!"

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then what are we, just stepping stones?!
Just extras who can't hold a candle to the "strongest" "monster"—that's all we are, right?!

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text:
That's right. No matter how desperately we run,
the crowd only cares about
how Brian is going to win.

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text: Because to everyone else, the hard work and dreams of side characters like us... aren't even worth caring about...!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The feeling of being compared to a "monster"
that everyone's watching like this...
Anyone who's never been compared to one will never understand!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That feeling of being so miserable and frustrated
that you just want to quit running altogether—
I definitely—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's how brightly Brian shines in your eyes, huh? ☆

text_block_list.name: Brian's Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Since you're closer to Brian than anyone else,
there's a marvelous side of Brian
that only you two can see☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, through all that pain and agony, there's no way you could keep Brian so firmly in your sights—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: More than "anyone else," you guys are the ones who can't take your eyes off Brian, aren't you?☆

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh, what is with that, it's seriously so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to tell me, I already know!
The one comparing me to Brian isn't everyone else—it's me!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But can you blame me?! When there's a "Monster" in your generation, how can you not compare yourself to her?!

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're always in sight, always the talk of the town,
it's not like I can even pretend not to see you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure that's true.
But that's not all—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Let's go――☆★

text_block_list.name: Brian's Classmates
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what the—?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look, look closely☆
Brian is right over there, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —GRAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Brian's Classmates
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text:
"She really is amazing...
So overwhelming... simply powerful..."

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text:
I'd never seen running so terrifying until I met Brian-san.
It was scary... yet I couldn't look away—

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was so frustrated I couldn't stand it!
By the time I realized it,
the gap between us had already grown insurmountable—

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even though I can't reach! Even though I can't get close!
No matter what, I just can't forget that run—

text_block_list.name: Brian's Classmates
text_block_list.text:
I see... The truth is, I wanted to be like that too—
I see... The truth is, I wanted to be like that too—

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text: ...Once you realize it, it feels kinda lame, huh?

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah... To think in the end, it was nothing more than an idle longing—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not at all☆
That feeling is simply marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Because strong feelings of admiration will drive you all forward! ☆★"

text_block_list.name: Brian's Classmates
text_block_list.text: Huh—?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Your yearning—so intense it hurts—will surely
carve its name into the history of Umamusume! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And the only ones who can witness that history
are the Umamusume born in the same era
as the one they admire—"Narita Brian"! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"So it'd be a waste not to chase after it! ☆
A Marvelous so strong it'll change history! ★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Since you all admire Brian's brilliant light,
guided by that shine,
you're sure to become so much more marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn that admiration into strength☆★
Because Brian's marvelousness will surely lead you all to what is truly marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text:
............
Turning admiration into strength――huh... Easy enough to say, though.

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it's better than sitting around smoldering.
Though she's still way too far out of reach to call a goal.

text_block_list.name: Confident Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Someday, even just a little more——

Unable to cut in, I simply watched over them,
but it seems a glimpse of Marvelous
was successfully conveyed.
Watching the senior Umamusume gaze at Narita Brian's run, the gloom from earlier seemed to have vanished from their faces.
—Yeah, you're right. Marvelous is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry for the sudden outburst.
I just got so excited when I realized
you felt the exact same way, Trainer-san.

The one calling out was Fuji Kiseki,
who was debuting in the same class as Marvelous Sunday.

A brilliant and powerful stride.
Though she has yet to make her debut, many are already captivated by her talent, eagerly awaiting her success.
Surprised to receive praise like 'amazing' from someone who already carries the aura of a true star—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did I say something so strange?
I mean, the smiles you make, Marvelous,
are truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why my eyes just follow her.
There's a lot to learn from her as an entertainer, too♪
choice_data_list: Do you really watch that closely?
Do you really watch that closely?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Especially at times like today.
I mean, that first impression was just way too strong—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When Marvelous moved into the dorms,
the little fillies around her
were terribly nervous, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"There were girls who were visibly homesick.
So, as the dorm head, I felt I had to support them, but—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! Believe in your own Marvelous ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You and I are both right here!
Companions sharing the same dream for the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We can make our dreams come true together☆
Isn't that just super marvelous?★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The nervous little pony was completely stunned by the sheer momentum—and then broke into a smile right away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's when I learned.
Marvelous is really good at finding
the positive side of whatever's in front of her."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I believe that is an essential ability for anyone who stands upon the stage as well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was lucky our debuts lined up.
Because with her, I feel like we can put on races everyone can enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run in the same race one day.
—Please tell her that for me♪"

On the way home that day, I spotted Marvelous Sunday
standing in a daze, which was rare for her.

Could she be nervous before her debut race?
Thinking that, I called out to her――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —I've always, always wondered about it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Everyone is so marvelous, so I wonder why they just don't realize it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"If only everyone could realize their own Marvelous,
the world would shine so much brighter—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Still, we can finally get started!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Even those who can't find the Marvelous on their own right now—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we show them lots of Marvelous things,
they'll surely come to realize
their own Marvelousness!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
My dream of spreading marvels...
I'm finally taking the very first step toward it☆★
choice_data_list: Let's do our best for the Make Debut!
Let's do our best for the Make Debut, okay?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yup☆ So the whole world can realize their own Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm running
in the Twinkle Series, after all! ☆★
